war_summary: War 139 is on day 101 with no winner and conquest conditions not yet met. The front remains sharply divided: Colonials hold full or near-full control in many regions (AcrithiaHex, AllodsBightHex, AshFieldsHex, DeadLandsHex, FarranacCoastHex, etc.), while Wardens dominate others (BasinSionnachHex, ClansheadValleyHex, HowlCountyHex, ReachingTrailHex, ViperPitHex, etc.). The heaviest fighting is localized to contested corridors—EndlessShoreHex, CallahansPassageHex, ClahstraHex, MarbanHollow, MooringCountyHex, and OarbreakerHex—where casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating sharply and strategic bases are actively flipping. Notably, EndlessShoreHex and OarbreakerHex show extreme event volumes (41 and 50 events in 24h, respectively) with multiple neutral and captured states, while CallahansPassageHex and ClahstraHex also display intense combat with recent ownership changes. Quieter regions show stable ownership with minimal combat, indicating strategic pressure is concentrated in these active zones.
